incident_message_interpretation: D4-A9-R2-Fail records the unaccepted D4-A9-R1 administrative incident; it is not scientific R2 authority.
freeze_guard: First live statement checks direct-parent incident commit, exact message, six-path checkpoint, ancestry, and committed/working verifier-script/test/contract identity.
synthetic_isolation: Supplied in-memory objects only; tests intercept builtin/io opens of embargo paths and all Git content readers. Static AST audit rejects raw path literals/constants and direct/aliased live entrypoint calls.

safety_authority.critical: src/panda_agent/evaluation.py:_matched_evidence_groups; approved Gold v2.6 required_evidence_groups with critical=true; treatment-only critical group loss.
safety_authority.version: src/panda_agent/evaluation.py deterministic evidence loop: item.source_version_id not in case.allowed_source_versions is a violation, including missing IDs. All final evidence is governed; not_governed=0.
safety_authority.grounding: Canonical object_lookup resolution as used by _matched_evidence_groups; exact canonical object_id/source_id/source_version_id identity; GoldEvidenceSelector.matches on frozen final evidence for forbidden_evidence, as in deterministic_metrics. Compute violations independently for both arms, subtract matching canonical identity and violation/selector. Required source types use the existing deterministic_metrics source_type/required_source_coverage logic; only treatment-only missing source types are regressions, with symmetric baseline accounting.
safety_authority.identity: Canonical lookup is indexed by object_id; comparisons retain canonical source_id and source_version_id, never collapse to an ancestor, path, or a merely similar object. Unresolved items retain their frozen exact object/source/version identity.
safety_authority.variance: Non-critical evidence additions/removals and final evidence order differences are diagnostic only; no overlap or ranking threshold.
safety_authority.plan_signature: Exact JSON signature semantics of D4-A5 compute_plan_signature; serialization is not a new scientific metric.
safety_authority.persistence: Read frozen executor at 8e332acb8a1d4658a860ad5e251c9223319bfa42 through Git; program order plus persisted_at <= gated_at, not disk reload.

blob_policy: Derive historical A9, failed-R1 and A8-R2 blobs from actual Git objects. Do not reuse failed R1 constants.
accounting_limit: Frozen A9 per-cell model_calls counts provider attempts; zero downstream categories cross-checked with historical A9 result. Successful persisted plans provide success receipts; absent separate failure counters are bounded by attempts equal logical calls and zero retries. AGY orchestration is separate; no AGY invoked in this R2 run.
local_lookup_limit: Use the existing latest-ingestion-report normalized catalog selection, read-only. Frozen evidence and locked catalog must resolve canonically. No database or provider access.
